title: SessionSignInSource
description: How a browser or device session signed in: 'local' on the home network or the hub computer (the default for any session recorded before this field existed), 'away' through the household's private Tailscale address, 'paired_device' by redeeming a paired device's token. The hub sets it on the server when it issues the session, once; a client never supplies it and it has no update path. Only the signed-in person reads it, for their own sessions.
